_comment: The case that actually happened. syft scanned node_modules with the lockfile cataloger instead of the package.json one, so the parts list was full and the terms were missing -- and the policy passed it and printed 'licences clean' having checked nothing. Must FAIL. 1 licensed in 20 is 5%, deliberately inside the refusal band rather than on its 10% edge, so this fixture proves the rule is a ratio and not a zero-check. The two measured real cases were worse: yarn.lock gave 2802 packages and 0 licences, and node_modules scanned with the wrong cataloger gave 1821 and 2.
